title: The 2026 Autumn Budget falls short of supporting young beauty workers
summary: The Autumn Budget has been unveiled for 2026, setting out an increase in Small Business Rates Relief and hikes in the National Living Wage. But does it go far enough in supporting youth employment? Cosmetics Business reveals everything beauty businesses need to know
